title: Analyst - Quality Assurance
description:
The Analyst, Quality Assurance (QA) is part of the Global Merchant Operations team within the Global Merchant & Network Services (GMNS) business unit. The Global Merchant Operations team partners across the business to enable trusted and frictionless merchant experiences by delivering resilient, compliant, and efficient operational processes that safeguard our network, reduce operational and financial crimes risk, and power-sustainable growth.
The Analyst will deliver independent, risk-based Quality Assurance across KYC Operations and KYC programs by executing assurance reviews, identifying control weaknesses, analyzing quality trends, and supporting continuous improvement to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies and operational standards.

- Executing independent, risk-based Quality Assurance reviews and sampling activities across KYC Operations, assessing CDD, ADD and pre-EDD processes for compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, procedures and control standards.

- Reviewing customer due diligence, risk assessments and supporting documentation to ensure decisions are appropriately evidenced and that Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) has been triggered where required.

- Documenting QA outcomes, identifying defects, control gaps, process weaknesses and regulatory risks, and escalating findings in accordance with established governance procedures.

- Analysing QA results and operational data to identify trends, emerging risks, root causes and opportunities to strengthen controls and improve quality outcomes.

- Preparing QA reporting, dashboards and management information to support governance, operational oversight and informed decision-making.

- Supporting remediation activities by tracking findings, validating corrective actions and confirming the effective resolution of quality issues.

- Partnering with Global Servicing, Compliance, Risk and other stakeholders to investigate findings, resolve quality issues and drive continuous process improvement.

- Maintaining QA documentation, review criteria, evidence repositories and audit trails, while supporting enhancements to QA procedures, checklists and methodologies to reflect policy, regulatory and business changes.

- Participating in QA calibration sessions, thematic reviews, audits, regulatory requests and special projects to promote consistency and continuous improvement.

- Maintaining a strong understanding of UK and international AML, KYC and Financial Crime regulatory requirements and industry best practices to support the effective execution of QA activities.

Minimum Qualifications:
- 2–4 years of relevant experience in Financial Crime Compliance, Quality Assurance, Operational Risk Management, or a related function within financial services. 

- Strong working knowledge of AML, KYC, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), and Financial Crime regulatory requirements across the UK and international jurisdictions. 

- Knowledge of UK Money Laundering Regulations, FCA expectations, FATF guidance and international AML regulatory requirements. 

- Experience supporting merchant services, including merchant onboarding, refresh, Additional Due Diligence (ADD), and ongoing KYC processes. 

- Experience performing independent Quality Assurance or Quality Control reviews within Financial Crimes. 

- Experience reviewing customer files against policy and regulatory requirements, identifying control gaps, documenting findings, and providing evidence-based recommendations. 

- Experience applying risk-based sampling methodologies, executing QA reviews, identifying trends, and supporting remediation activities. 

- Strong attention to detail with excellent analytical, problem-solving, written and verbal communication skills. 

- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and reporting tools, with the ability to analyse data and produce meaningful management information. 

- Professional AML qualification (e.g., ICA, ACAMS) preferred or a willingness to obtain one. 

- Ability to work collaboratively across multiple stakeholders while managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: QA Engineer / Tester – ServiceNow Platform
description:
Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.

Roles & Responsibilities :

Role summary
Makes sure every change to the ServiceNow platform works, is safe to release and doesn't break what already works. Designs and runs functional, regression, integration and user-acceptance testing, builds automated tests with the Automated Test Framework (ATF) and other tools, and works inside Agile DevOps teams so testing happens during the sprint, not after it. During the transition, builds the regression suites that must run before each wave goes live. Good exposure to Agile methodology.
 
Job Description or Responsibilities
 
Test planning and design
· Take part in backlog refinement to make acceptance criteria clear and testable before development starts.
· Write test plans, test scenarios and test cases for stories, releases and platform upgrades.
· Use a risk-based approach: focus test effort on critical services, high-volume catalog items, integrations and security-sensitive changes.
· Prepare and manage test data in non-production instances, including masked data where needed.
Functional and regression testing
· Test changes across ServiceNow modules: ITSM, Service Catalog and order forms, Enterprise IT Hub, knowledge, Feedback Hub, Workflow Studio flows and approvals.
· Run end-to-end tests from request to fulfillment, including approvals, task creation, notifications, SLAs and fulfillment integrations.
· Test roles and access: confirm users see and do only what their roles allow, using impersonation.
· Test portal usability, responsiveness and accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) on desktop and mobile.
· Test translated order forms and knowledge articles in every supported language.
Test automation
· Build and maintain ATF test suites for catalog items, forms, flows, portal pages and server-side logic.
· Run ATF suites in CI/CD pipelines as quality gates before promotion, and keep them stable and fast.
· Use additional tools where ATF is not enough, such as Selenium, Playwright or Tricentis Tosca for browser tests and Postman for API tests.
· Track automation coverage and grow it sprint by sprint.
Integration, AI and non-functional testing
· Test integrations end to end, including REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, OpenText Automation Bus, Genesys and SMARA. Cover error handling, retries and failure scenarios.
· Test AI services such as BD Assist, Now Assist skills, AI Agent Studio agents and AI cases: answer accuracy against test sets, safe handling of sensitive topics, guardrail behavior, hand-off to live agents, and regression after model or Store app updates.
· Support performance and load testing for high-volume portals and catalog items.
· Support security testing with the security architect, such as access control and input validation checks.
Release and upgrade quality
· Run regression testing for platform upgrades, patches and Store app updates, and report skipped records and broken behavior.
· Coordinate and support user acceptance testing with process owners and catalog owners.
· Give a clear go/no-go recommendation on test results for each release.
Defect management and quality reporting
· Log defects with clear steps, evidence and severity, and verify fixes.
· Report test progress, pass rates, defect trends and automation coverage to the team and the quality lead.
· Find recurring defect patterns and suggest improvements to development and design practices.

Experience and qualifications
 
- Hands-on experience building and running ATF tests.

- Good functional knowledge of ServiceNow: Service Catalog, flows and approvals, portals, roles and ACLs, ITSM processes.

- Experience with API testing (Postman or similar) and at least one browser automation tool (Selenium, Playwright, Tosca or similar).

- Basic JavaScript, enough to read scripts and write ATF server-side test steps.

- Experience with test management and defect tracking tools (ServiceNow Test Management, Jira, Xray, Azure DevOps or similar).

- Experience testing in Agile DevOps teams and in CI/CD pipelines.

- Understanding of ITIL processes, especially Request Fulfilment and Incident.

- Clear written communication for test cases, defect reports and test summaries.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field.

- Certifications

- Required: ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (or equivalent).

- Preferred: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA); ISTQB Agile Tester or Test Automation Engineer; ServiceNow ATF learning paths or micro-certifications on Now Learning (check the current catalog).

- Nice to have

- Hands-on experience using GenAI tools such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot

- Ability to use AI tools for:
- Test scenario and test case generation.

- Automation script creation and optimization.

- Test data generation.

- Exposure to AI-enabled testing frameworks and agent-based testing approaches.

- Knowledge of ServiceNow Now Assist, Virtual Agent, and AI-powered features is an added advantage

- Experience testing multilingual applications.

- Experience testing chatbots, virtual agents or other AI features.

- Performance testing experience (JMeter or similar).

- Accessibility testing tools (axe, WAVE, screen readers).

- Experience with ServiceNow Test Management 2.0.

Educational qualification:
BE/B-Tech/MCA
Experience :
3-5 Years
Mandatory/requires Skills :

ServiceNow Now Assist, Virtual Agent, and AI-powered Testing
Preferred Skills :

title: QA Automation Specialist – ServiceNow Platform
description:
Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.

Roles & Responsibilities :

Role summary
Designs, builds and owns test automation for the ServiceNow platform. Sets up the automation framework, standards and CI/CD quality gates so every team can release quickly and safely. Builds Automated Test Framework (ATF) and external test suites for catalog items, portals, workflows, integrations and AI services, keeps them stable and fast, and coaches testers and developers to automate as part of normal sprint work.
 
Job Description or Responsibilities
 
Automation strategy and framework
· Define the test automation strategy for the platform: what to automate at each level (unit, server-side, UI, API, end to end), tool choices and coverage targets.
· Design and maintain the ATF framework: suite structure, naming, reusable test templates and step configurations, parameterized and data-driven tests, and test data set-up and clean-up.
· Build an external automation framework where ATF falls short, using Playwright, Selenium or Tricentis Tosca for cross-browser UI tests and Postman/Newman or REST Assured for API tests.
· Set automation standards and review automated tests written by testers and developers.
· Keep the framework maintainable and upgrade-safe, with fewer brittle UI tests and more server-side and API tests.
CI/CD quality gates
· Integrate ATF and external suites into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins), using the ServiceNow CI/CD APIs to trigger suites and read results.
· Define quality gates for promotion between instances: required suites, pass thresholds, Instance Scan results and blocking rules.
· Set up scheduled regression runs, headless or cloud-based runners where available, and parallel execution to keep run times short.
· Publish results to dashboards and alert teams on failures.
Upgrades and non-functional testing
· Build and run the upgrade regression pack for platform releases, patches and Store app updates.
· Set up performance and load tests for high-volume portals and catalog items with JMeter, k6 or similar.
· Support security testing with the security architect through automated access and input-validation checks.
· Coach testers and developers on writing good automated tests, and run training on ATF and the framework.
· Work with lead developers so new features are built in a testable way

Experience and qualifications
 
- Expert ATF knowledge: server-side and client-side steps, custom step configurations, test templates, parameterized tests, suites and scheduled runs.

- Strong programming skills in JavaScript or TypeScript, plus working knowledge of Python or Java.

- Hands-on experience with at least one browser automation framework (Playwright, Selenium or Tosca) and one API testing tool.

- Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and source control (Git).

- Good ServiceNow functional and technical knowledge: catalog, flows, portals, ACLs, REST APIs and instance management.

- Experience designing test data strategies and handling test environments.

- Experience with performance testing tools.

- Experience in Agile DevOps teams, and coaching others on test automation.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.

- Certifications

- Required: ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (or equivalent).

- Preferred: ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineer; ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA); ServiceNow ATF learning paths or micro-certifications on Now Learning (check the current catalog).

- Nice to have

- Experience testing chatbots, virtual agents or large language model features.

- Experience with contract testing (such as Pact) and service virtualization.

- Hands-on experience using GenAI tools such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot

- Ability to use AI tools for:
- Test scenario and test case generation.

- Automation script creation and optimization.

- Test data generation.

- Test result analysis and defect identification.

- Test coverage analysis and test documentation.

- Exposure to AI-enabled testing frameworks and agent-based testing approaches.

Knowledge of ServiceNow Now Assist, Virtual Agent, and AI-powered features is an added advantage.

Educational qualification:
BE/B-Tech/MCA
Experience :
5-9 Years
Mandatory/requires Skills :

ServiceNow (5 to 9 years in software testing, with at least 4 years focused on test automation and at least 2 years automating ServiceNow)
Preferred Skills :

AI-enabled testing frameworks

We are proponents of leveraging best-in-breed AI tools at every step of the engineering lifecycle — design, development, review, and testing. title: QA Engineer: Data-Driven Applications
description:
API, UI & Data Validation

Hands-on API and UI testing required | Data validation experience valued

About The Role

We're hiring a QA Engineer to own quality across our procurement intelligence platform, from the screens and APIs our users interact with to the data behind them. You will test the product as a user would (UI), as a system would (APIs), and as a skeptic would (the data), confirming that what is ingested, stored and displayed is accurate and consistent. This is a QA engineering role, not a data engineering role. You will test and verify data pipelines, not build them.

What You'd Be Testing

UI: Contract views, category playbooks, supplier profiles, dashboards and in-app chat. We check that what users see matches what is stored.

APIs: The services that serve and update contracts, suppliers, categories and spend data, including request/response contracts, error handling, and authorization.

Data: Spend file ingestion, transformation and mapping, and storage. We trace data to every downstream surface to confirm it stays correct at each hop.

What You'll Do

- Design, execute and maintain functional, regression and exploratory test suites for web UI and REST APIs.
- Test APIs with tools such as Postman or REST Assured. Validate status codes, schemas, payloads, pagination, negative cases and security basics.
- Automate UI and API tests with frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or equivalent, and integrate them into CI/CD.
- Validate spend file ingestion end-to-end, from source file to stored record to downstream UI and API output (contracts, category playbooks, supplier master).
- Verify spend totals, supplier/contract field accuracy, and duplicate or near-duplicate records, comparing source files against what the product displays rather than trusting dashboard output at face value.
- Design edge-case tests: missing or malformed fields, inconsistent formats, conflicting supplier records, expired vs. active contracts, and template/schema mismatches.
- Use browser/network tools and logs to isolate whether a defect originates in the UI, the API, or the data layer.
- Build automated checks for ongoing quality monitoring, not just one-off spot checks.
- Partner with engineering and category/procurement teams to root-cause defects, write clear bug reports, and flag when a data model or template is missing a field it should capture.

You Might Be a Fit If You Have

- Required: Hands-on UI testing and API testing experience in web applications.
- Required: Experience with test automation (UI and/or API) and a working understanding of test strategy: smoke, regression, integration and exploratory testing.
- Required: A risk-based mindset, able to decide what to test deeply and what to spot-check under time constraints.
- Experience validating structured business data, and reasoning about what can break between a source file and the final record a user sees.
- Clear written communication: reproducible bug reports, evidence (screenshots, queries, logs) and good judgment on severity.

Nice to Have

- SQL, to independently verify data in the database.
- ETL / data pipeline testing experience, including log-based debugging across multi-step pipelines.
- Experience with procurement, sourcing, spend, contract or supplier data.
- Familiarity with orchestration tools, CI/CD, and Jira-based defect workflows.

As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) on Bitwarden’s Autofill Coverage team, you will help make autofill work reliably on the sites people actually use, and keep it fast and unobtrusive as the product evolves. Autofill is the Bitwarden capability that fills logins, payment details, and identities into web forms across browsers. The Autofill Coverage team maintains and expands a curated dataset of site-specific autofill rules, builds automation that continuously checks autofill across popular websites, and builds lab-based measurement of autofill’s performance in the browser. Every engineer on the team works across all of this, so we value curiosity and range over a perfect match to any single tool. This is a hands-on role. You will spend your time writing, reviewing, and shipping code, alongside your teammatesand in close partnership with the wider Autofill team.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Trustworthy Results: Make sure test and benchmark results can be relied on. Confirm that two runs did the same work before comparing them, and flag misleading metrics before anyone acts on them.
- Test Scenarios: Build and maintain test pages that recreate tricky real-world patterns, such as dynamic forms, shadow DOM, and iframes, so they can be tested repeatably.
- Failure Triage: Reproduce autofill failures found by automation, support, or internal reports. Document them clearly, hand dataset fixes to teammates, and route the rest to the right owner.
- Reporting and Observability: Publish results to dashboards, set up alerting on regressions, and report coverage and trends on a regular cadence.
- AI-Assisted Development: Use AI coding assistants effectively in daily engineering and exercise judgement about where they help and where they do not. Help keep test documentation and Claude skills current as new autofill code lands.
- Learning and Collaboration: Pair with senior engineers on hard problems, share what you learn, and review teammates’ pull requests with care.
- Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Software Engineer teammates, the Autofill team, Product, and Security on triage, test strategy, and release coordination.

- Technical Stack: We value strong automation fundamentals and a performance mindset over an exact tool match. Experience with load-testing tools such as JMeter or k6 is welcome, but this role centres on performance inside the browser.
- Expertise- UI automation with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium/WebDriver, or Puppeteer, including stable locators, waits, and handling flaky tests JavaScript or TypeScript, and Node.js HTML, the DOM, and CSS selectors Front-end performance testing with the Chrome DevTools Performance panel, Lighthouse, WebPageTest, or Core Web Vitals tooling
- Experience- CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar, and running tests in Docker. Interpreting performance results: percentiles, variance, and comparing runs fairly Dashboards and alerting with Datadog, Grafana, New Relic, or similar. The QA Engineer will be responsible for ensuring product quality, reliability and performance through a balanced combination of manual and automated testing.

The role requires approximately **50% manual testing and 50% automation testing**, with hands-on experience in designing, developing and executing test cases, alongside building and maintaining automated test scripts using **TypeScript and Selenium WebDriver**.

You will work closely with engineering, product and QA teams to define test strategies, identify potential risks, improve test coverage and integrate automated testing into the software development lifecycle. **1. Manual Testing (50%)**

* Perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory and smoke testing.
* Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases.
* Execute manual test cases to validate application functionality, usability and reliability.
* Identify, document, track and validate defects, working closely with development teams for resolution.
* Participate in test planning, requirement reviews and defect triage discussions.

**2. Test Automation (50%)**

* Design, develop and maintain automated test scripts using TypeScript and Selenium WebDriver.
* Build and enhance reusable automation components, frameworks and test suites.
* Identify suitable test scenarios for automation and continuously improve automation coverage.
* Develop and maintain regression and end-to-end automation suites.
* Debug automation failures and ensure test scripts remain reliable and maintainable.

**3. API Integration Testing**

* Perform API testing using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Validate backend workflows, integrations, data processing and application responses.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to investigate and resolve integration-related issues.

**4. Continuous Testing Collaboration**

* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
* Work within Agile development teams and actively participate in sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with developers, product managers and other QA engineers to ensure quality throughout the SDLC.
* Leverage AI-assisted tools to improve test case generation, automation development and overall testing efficiency.

  
  
 **Qualifications Experience**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or an equivalent discipline.
* 5+ years of hands-on professional experience in software testing, covering both manual and automation testing.
* Strong practical experience in manual testing, including functional, regression, integration, exploratory and smoke testing.
* Hands-on experience with **TypeScript and Selenium WebDriver** is mandatory.
* Experience developing and maintaining automation frameworks, reusable components and automated test scripts.
* Good understanding of API testing using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, test case design, defect lifecycle and Agile methodologies.
* Experience with source code management tools such as Git/GitHub.
* Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.

  
  
**Good to Have**  

* Working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, JSON, SQL and Unix/Linux environments.
* Exposure to modern automation frameworks such as Playwright or Cypress.
* Familiarity with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling or LoadRunner.
* Experience using AI-assisted tools for test case generation, test automation and debugging.
* Understanding of continuous testing practices and quality engineering principles.

  
  
**Desired Competencies**  

* Strong analytical, debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to independently own testing activities across manual and automation tracks.
* Strong attention to detail and a quality-first mindset.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to balance functional testing requirements with automation objectives.

As a Software Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Infrastructure Platforms team, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile delivery team to validate and assure market-leading ServiceNow solutions in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for executing and improving testing practices across ServiceNow applications and workflows, ensuring releases meet functional, integration, performance, and control requirements in support of the firm's business objectives.  
  
**Job responsibilities**

* Execute QA activities including test planning, test case creation, test execution, defect triage, and test reporting for ServiceNow releases (e.g., ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SecOps as applicable).
* Design and maintain the scalable manual and automated regression and performance test suites for ServiceNow configurations and customizations (workflows/Flow Designer, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, integrations, portals).
* Perform functional, regression, smoke, integration, and end-to-end testing across ServiceNow and upstream/downstream systems (APIs, MID Server, SSO, CMDB-related integrations).
* Partner with developers, product owners, and platform teams to review requirements and acceptance criteria, identify test scenarios, and ensure appropriate coverage and traceability.
* Log, track, and manage defects with clear reproduction steps, severity/priority, and evidence; validate fixes and support release readiness decisions.
* Produce and maintain test artifacts (test plans, test cases, test data approach, RTM as needed) and contribute to release documentation and operational readiness.
* Analyze testing results and trends to identify recurring defects, root causes, and quality risks, recommending improvements to process, controls, and platform hygiene.
* Support CI/CD quality gates by integrating testing into pipelines where applicable and promoting consistent QA standards across environments (DEV/TEST/UAT/PROD).
* Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience
* Hands-on practical experience in QA/testing within the Software Development Life Cycle, including test design, execution, defect management, and release validation.
* Experience testing ServiceNow configurations/customizations and understanding of core platform components (tables, forms, lists, ACLs, notifications, workflows/Flow Designer).
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and QA in iterative release cycles; familiarity with CI/CD concepts and environment promotion practices.
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow Agile Development, or similar).
* Basic understanding of web technologies and APIs (HTTP, REST, JSON) and ability to validate integrations using logs and test tools (e.g., Postman or equivalent).
* Ability to create clear, actionable documentation and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Understanding of security and controls concepts relevant to testing (e.g., access controls/roles, data handling, auditability, evidence capture).
* Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience with ServiceNow test automation (e.g., ATF – Automated Test Framework) and/or automation frameworks/tools used alongside ServiceNow.
* Familiarity with CMDB and ITIL-aligned processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Asset/Discovery).
* Exposure to performance testing concepts and non-functional testing (availability, resiliency, audit/compliance readiness).
* Experience validating SSO, LDAP, and multi-system integrations involving MID Server, integration hubs, or enterprise APIs.

* Test translated order forms and knowledge articles in every supported language.

**Test automation**

* Build and maintain ATF test suites for catalog items, forms, flows, portal pages and server-side logic.
* Run ATF suites in CI/CD pipelines as quality gates before promotion, and keep them stable and fast.
* Use additional tools where ATF is not enough, such as Selenium, Playwright or Tricentis Tosca for browser tests and Postman for API tests.
* Track automation coverage and grow it sprint by sprint.

**Integration, AI and non-functional testing**

* Test integrations end to end, including REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, OpenText Automation Bus, Genesys and SMARA. Cover error handling, retries and failure scenarios.
* Test AI services such as BD Assist, Now Assist skills, AI Agent Studio agents and AI cases: answer accuracy against test sets, safe handling of sensitive topics, guardrail behavior, hand-off to live agents, and regression after model or Store app updates.
* Support performance and load testing for high-volume portals and catalog items.
* Support security testing with the security architect, such as access control and input validation checks.

**Release and upgrade quality**

* Run regression testing for platform upgrades, patches and Store app updates, and report skipped records and broken behavior.
* Coordinate and support user acceptance testing with process owners and catalog owners.
* Give a clear go/no-go recommendation on test results for each release.

**Defect management and quality reporting**

* Log defects with clear steps, evidence and severity, and verify fixes.
* Report test progress, pass rates, defect trends and automation coverage to the team and the quality lead.
* Find recurring defect patterns and suggest improvements to development and design practices.

**Experience and qualifications**

* Hands-on experience building and running ATF tests.
* Good functional knowledge of ServiceNow: Service Catalog, flows and approvals, portals, roles and ACLs, ITSM processes.
* Experience with API testing (Postman or similar) and at least one browser automation tool (Selenium, Playwright, Tosca or similar).
* Basic JavaScript, enough to read scripts and write ATF server-side test steps.
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools (ServiceNow Test Management, Jira, Xray, Azure DevOps or similar).
* Experience testing in Agile DevOps teams and in CI/CD pipelines.
* Understanding of ITIL processes, especially Request Fulfilment and Incident.
* Clear written communication for test cases, defect reports and test summaries.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field.
* **Certifications**
* Required: ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (or equivalent).
* Preferred: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA); ISTQB Agile Tester or Test Automation Engineer; ServiceNow ATF learning paths or micro-certifications on Now Learning (check the current catalog).
* **Nice to have**
* Hands-on experience using GenAI tools such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot
* Ability to use AI tools for:

  + Test scenario and test case generation.
  + Automation script creation and optimization.
  + Test data generation.
* Exposure to AI-enabled testing frameworks and agent-based testing approaches.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow Now Assist, Virtual Agent, and AI-powered features is an added advantage
* Experience testing multilingual applications.
* Experience testing chatbots, virtual agents or other AI features.
* Performance testing experience (JMeter or similar).
* Accessibility testing tools (axe, WAVE, screen readers).
* Experience with ServiceNow Test Management 2.0.

description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q2 FY27 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens™ Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Firmware Automation Engineer with 5 to 8 years of experience in firmware validation, embedded systems testing, and automation engineering. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Python programming, automation framework development, and firmware testing methodologies. This role is responsible for designing and implementing scalable automation solutions, improving test coverage, enhancing product quality, and supporting the validation of complex firmware and embedded platforms.

  

* **Role: Senior Firmware Automation Engineer**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: 5 to 8 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Design, develop, and maintain automated testing frameworks for firmware and embedded products.
* Develop Python-based automation solutions to validate firmware functionality, stability, and performance.
* Build automated test suites covering functional, integration, regression, system, and reliability testing requirements.
* Collaborate with firmware developers, validation engineers, hardware teams, and architects to define effective test strategies.
* Analyze product requirements and convert them into scalable automation solutions.
* Validate firmware behavior across multiple hardware configurations and environments.
* Investigate and resolve issues related to automation infrastructure, test environments, and test execution failures.
* Work effectively within complex and evolving environments where systems, documentation, and processes may require improvement.
* Create and maintain reusable testing frameworks, libraries, utilities, and automation tools.
* Identify gaps in testing coverage and recommend improvements to increase product quality.
* Execute automated test suites, analyze failures, and perform root-cause investigations.
* Participate in defect reviews and collaborate with engineering teams to resolve product issues.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives for automation processes, tools, and validation methodologies.
* Document automation solutions, test strategies, execution procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
* Mentor junior engineers and promote automation best practices across the engineering team.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 5 to 8 years of experience in Firmware Testing, Embedded Systems Validation, or Automation Engineering.
* Strong programming expertise in Python for automation development and test framework creation.
* Extensive experience working with firmware-based and embedded products.
* Proven track record of developing and maintaining automation frameworks for complex systems.
* Hands-on automation experience representing a significant portion of previous project responsibilities.
* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies including functional, regression, integration, system, and end-to-end testing.
* Experience creating scalable and maintainable automated test solutions.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis capabilities.
* Ability to work independently and solve problems in complex technical environments.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working with hardware-software integrated systems.
* Knowledge of firmware validation processes, release cycles, and quality assurance practices.
* Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and project requirements.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment
  

**Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent -** **persistent.com/careers**

  

***"Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.*****"**

title: Quality Assurance Engineer II
description:
**Company Introduction**
========================

Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows.

Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles & Responsibilities**
============================

At Availity, we're not just another Healthcare Technology company; we're pioneers reshaping the future of healthcare! With our headquarters in vibrant Jacksonville, FL, and an exciting office in Bangalore, India, along with an exceptional remote workforce across the United States, we're a global team united by a powerful mission.

We're on a mission to bring the focus back to what truly matters – patient care. As the leading healthcare engagement platform, we're the heartbeat of an industry that impacts millions. With over 2 million providers connected to health plans, and processing over 12 billion transactions annually, our influence is continually expanding.

Join our energetic, dynamic, and forward-thinking team where your ideas are celebrated, innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. We're transforming the healthcare landscape, solving communication challenges, and creating connections that empower the nation's premier healthcare ecosystem.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced **Quality Assurance Engineer** to join our Bengaluru team and help continuously improve the quality of Availity’s product portfolio. In this role, you will build and enhance test automation frameworks, create robust automated tests using **Selenium, Cucumber BDD, and Java**, and support functional, regression, integration, API, and microservices testing. You will collaborate closely with developers, product managers, product owners, and system analysts to improve test coverage, resolve defects, strengthen test stability, and deliver reliable, customer-focused releases.

**Key** **Responsibilities**

* Build new test automation frameworks and enhance existing solutions using **Selenium, Cucumber BDD, and Java**.
* Develop and maintain **Gherkin feature files, step definitions, and reliable automated test suites**.
* Perform **functional, regression, integration, API.**
* Collaborate with developers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, troubleshoot automation failures, and deliver stable, high-quality releases.

**Required Qualifications**

* **4+ years of experience** in software testing, including at least **3 years in test automation**.
* Strong hands-on expertise in **Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber BDD, Java, and Gherkin**.
* Experience with **CI/CD environments, Git workflows, REST API testing.**
* Strong **analytical, problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and leadership skills**.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing or improving **test automation frameworks from scratch**.
* Familiarity with executing automation in **distributed environments**.
* Ability to contribute to **test resilience, acceptance criteria, and continuous quality improvements.**

**Why Join Availity India?**

* **Meaningful impact:** Work on solutions that help simplify healthcare administration and support better provider and patient experiences.
* **Global exposure:** Partner with U.S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities.
* **Learning and growth:** Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development.
* **Flexible work experience:** Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office-based models.
* **Holistic rewards:** Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs.
* **Inclusive workplace:** Join a casual, collaborative, and inclusive environment where associates are encouraged to bring ideas forward.
* **Office experience:** For office-based associates, Availity India provides amenities such as coffee and tea, subsidized meals, recreation areas, and eligible night-shift transportation support.

**What to Expect from the Hiring Process**

Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and engaging. Depending on the role, it may include application review, recruiter discussion, technical or functional assessment, hiring manager interviews, team or leadership conversations, offer discussion, background verification, and onboarding support.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Availity is committed to building an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage individuals who are excited by collaboration, innovation, and meaningful impact to apply.

**Eligibility**
===============

***Video Camera Usage:***

*Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.*

*Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non-participants.*
